import sys, json, random, time, ctypes
sys.path.insert(0,'.'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/dev')
ctypes.CDLL('/workspace/vendor/system-libs/libz.so.1', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
import numpy as np
from netnomos.learners.hittingset import enumerate_minimal_clauses

rng = random.Random(1)
m = 10000; u = 65536; P = 32; width = 4
# structure: 4 groups of 8 predicates; each predicate true everywhere except one group's windows
T = []
for g in range(4):
    for k in range(8):
        bits = set(range(m)) - set(range(g*m//4, (g+1)*m//4))
        v = 0
        for b in bits: v |= 1 << b
        T.append(v)
U = []
for i in range(P):
    bits = [r for r in range(u) if rng.random() < 0.5]
    v = 0
    for b in bits: v |= 1 << b
    U.append(v)
t0=time.time()
found = enumerate_minimal_clauses(T, U, width, m, u)
print(f'grouped masks: {len(found)} clauses in {time.time()-t0:.2f}s')

# random dense masks
T2 = []
for i in range(P):
    bits = [r for r in range(m) if rng.random() < 0.75]
    v = 0
    for b in bits: v |= 1 << b
    T2.append(v)
t0=time.time()
found2 = enumerate_minimal_clauses(T2, U, width, m, u)
print(f'random dense: {len(found2)} clauses in {time.time()-t0:.2f}s')
EOF
